note: The seouterwall kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). The host's ground layers (47-host-land.js): ground.puna (the col's dry bunchgrass, the base, tinted by season), ground.cobble (ground.wadi.cobble: the meltwater gully's floor and its fan, the outwash flat), ground.gravel (ground.gravel019: the moraines' till and the scree), ground.tundra (the moraines' turf, the dwarf shrubs in the lee), ground.lichen (ground.lichen.crust: the crags' fellfield and the high slopes), ground.needles (the larch's litter in the sheltered shaded hollows), rock.megabreccia (the crags and the walls, read from the side on the steep: KGROUND's triplanar sides; tinted by KSTRATA's megabreccia and tibasalt columns; the rockfall heaps' blocks), rock.basalt (rock.basalt.titanium: the same on the Godthrone's side of the corridor, station 2's headwall: SITE.rock.lib). The flora's cards and barks are the NW outer wall's pack, read in place. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/seouterwall after any change, then python3 build.py. road.ancient (concrete.ancient: the Ancients' highway's pavement, station 1; its own mesh, not a ground layer). The kit's own plants' slots (50-biome-seow-species.js, BIO.libSwap), one cell of each nine-plant sheet: puya (card.puya, a rosette: row 1), puyaspike (card.puya in flower: row 3), guyedstalk (card.guyedstalk), skypoppy and goldpoppy (card.flower.bloom.highland: the blue-violet and the gold), goldroot (card.crop.thule row 3: roseroot, as the NW outer wall's). ground.sinter (station 3's second ground layer in place of the needles: the terraces' apron and the vents' warm ground; SITE.layer1). rock.limestone.karst (station 5's rock layer: the polje's reef limestone, SITE.rock.lib).
